nodes.statement: There are universal a>=1 and 0<b<1 such that every epsilon-successful strategy for an admissible QPBT game admits local isometries extracting 2^m q-dimensional EPR pairs and mapping total X/Z measurements close to ideal Pauli measurements with robustness a(md)^a(epsilon^b+q^-b+2^-bmd).
